title: Create:Automata Official
description: Create: Automata is a heavily industrial and exploration-focused Minecraft 1.21.1 modpack built around Minecraft and the Create ecosystem. It combines advanced engineering, automation, airship technology
body:
Create: Automata is a Create-focused survival modpack built around automation, engineering, and multiplayer collaboration.

Begin with simple mechanical systems and gradually expand into larger production lines using the Create mod's machinery. Design factories, automate resource processing, build transportation networks, and develop interconnected systems that grow alongside your world.

The pack encourages players to experiment with engineering solutions, optimize production, and work together to create larger projects. Whether you're constructing compact workshops or sprawling industrial complexes, progression is driven by creativity and automation.

Create: Automata is designed for players who enjoy mechanical progression, large-scale building, and cooperative gameplay on small servers.

If you're looking for a survival experience centered on machines, logistics, and engineering, Create: Automata offers a world where every system can be refined, expanded, and automated.
